Tortilla Mexican Grill plc, the largest fast-casual Mexican restaurant business in the UK and Europe, is pleased to announce the successful completion of its placing (the "Placing"), raising, in aggregate, gross proceeds of approximately £2.5 million. A total of 3,866,400 new ordinary shares in the Company ("New Ordinary Shares") have been placed by Panmure Liberum Limited ("Panmure Liberum"), with investors at a price of 65 pence per Placing Share (the "Placing Price") via an accelerated bookbuild.

The Placing Price represents a discount of 8.5% to the closing price of 71 pence per existing Ordinary Share on 15 October 2026 (being the latest practicable date prior to the release of this Announcement). The Placing was conducted using the Company's existing share authorities. The New Ordinary Shares issued will represent approximately 9% of the enlarged issued ordinary share capital (excluding treasury shares) of the Company following the Placing.
Panmure Liberum acted as Nominated Adviser, Sole Broker and Sole Bookrunner in connection to the Placing.
Director and persons closely associated with a PDMR participation

Richard Haley, CFO, has purchased 50,715 New Ordinary Shares. Following Admission, Richard Haley will hold 100,000 Ordinary Shares, representing approximately 0.2 per cent of the share capital of the Company post Admission.

Jennifer Roebuck, a person closely associated with Brandon Stephens, the Company's Founder & CEO, purchased 117,932 New Ordinary Shares. Following Admission Jennifer Roebuck will hold 3,402,435 Ordinary Shares, representing approximately 8.0 per cent of the share capital of the Company post Admission.
Admission of Ordinary Shares to trading on AIM

Application has been made to the London Stock Exchange for the Placing Shares to be admitted to trading on AIM ("Admission"). It is expected that Admission will become effective and that dealings in the Placing Shares will commence at 8.00 a.m. on or around 20 October 2026. The Placing Shares will, when issued, be credited as fully paid and will be issued subject to the Company's articles of association and will rank pari passu in all respects with the existing issued Ordinary Shares.
The Placing is conditional upon, inter alia, Admission becoming effective and the Placing Agreement not being terminated in accordance with its terms.

Following Admission, the Company's enlarged issued ordinary share capital will be 42,530,431. The Company does not hold any shares in treasury. Therefore, with effect from Admission, this figure may be used by Shareholders as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, the Company under the Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules of the FCA.

Terms used but not defined elsewhere in this Announcement shall have the meanings given to such terms in the definitions section in Appendix II of the announcement made yesterday (the "Launch Announcement") regarding the launch of a Placing, save where context otherwise dictates.
The person responsible for arranging for the release of this Announcement is Richard Haley.

Details of the person discharging managerial responsibilities / person closely associated

This notification concerns a person closely associated with a person discharging managerial responsibilities. The person discharging managerial responsibilities is Brandon Stephens, the issuer's CEO. The association arises by virtue of Jennifer Roebuck being the spouse of Mr. Stephens.
